rationale.oversight-theater: Defines rubber-stamp review lacking authority, information, time, and practical influence.
rationale.automation-bias: Substantively analyzes overdependence, complacent approvals, fatigue, and declining reviewer judgment.
rationale.risk-routing: Operationalizes computed triggers, thresholds, tiers, and SLAs for human allocation.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines override authority and checkpoints immediately before irreversible decision execution.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Provides reviewers reasons, uncertainty, provenance, counterfactuals, and decision guidance.
rationale.org-governance: Specifies roles, QA, governance cadences, audit logging, and corrective actions.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps controls and evidence to EU, ISO, and NIST requirements.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires persistent evidence chains linking outputs, triggers, reviewers, rationales, and outcomes.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes checkbox HITL as symbolic compliance without meaningful human agency.
rationale.framework: Presents a reusable intervention architecture and operating model for automated decisions.
rationale.design-only: Specifies buildable controls, thresholds, metrics, and workflows without implementation evidence.
rationale.general-ai: Targets high-stakes automated AI decisions broadly, not AI-generated code.
rationale.metrics: Defines metrics measuring over-reliance and bias in human intervention effectiveness.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally treats excessive model dependence and contributes controls measuring its effects.
rationale.risk-bias: Contributes fairness triggers, segment monitoring, disagreement analysis, and corrective controls.
